description_en: Queries the administrative regions in China from which requests are sent to one or more Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances within a specified period of time
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内DDoS高防实例的请求来源（中国）省份分布
name: DescribePortViewSourceProvinces

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs to the default resource group.

For information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not configure this parameter, the current system time is used as the end time.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。不传入表示使用当前时间作为结束时间。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

SourceProvinces.description_en: The details of the administrative region in China from which the requests are sent
SourceProvinces.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的请求来源中国地域信息

Count.description_en:
The total number of requests that are sent from the ISP.

This parameter does not indicate the accurate number of requests. You can use this parameter to calculate the proportion of requests from different administrative regions in China
Count.description_zh:
相对请求数量。

该数据不表示真实请求数量的大小，目前您可以使用该数据来计算不同省份请求数量的比例

ProvinceId.description_en:
The ID of the administrative region in China from which the requests are sent. For example, 110000 indicates Beijing, and 120000 indicates Tianjin.

For more information, see [Location parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
ProvinceId.description_zh:
请求来源中国地域的ID。例如，110000表示北京市，120000表示天津市。

关于该参数的取值，请参见[地域类型参数取值说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
